title: Mercy Day
description: Join us as we love and serve our neighbors across Greater New Haven with practical mercy projects.

title: Congregational Meeting
description: Annual congregational meeting following morning worship to discuss church life, ministry updates, and leadership.

title: Sunday School Begins
description: Fall classes begin for all ages! Children's Sunday School and Adult Sunday Studies meet Sundays at 9:30am.

title: Welcome Sunday & Ministry Fair
description: Welcome to the new academic year! Join us for worship, fellowship lunch, and our annual ministry fair to connect with teams and ministries.

title: Men’s Discipleship Gathering
description: An evening of food, fellowship, and encouragement for the men of CPC as we kick off the fall season together.

title: Women’s Conference at CPC
description: Annual CPC Women's Conference featuring guest teaching, fellowship, worship, and discussion.

title: Parenting Seminar
description: Saturday from 9–11:30am in the Fellowship Hall with light breakfast and childcare provided. Cross-pollination and encouragement for parents of all stages.

title: Thanksgiving Fellowship Meals
description: Staying local for Thanksgiving? Celebrate with your church family! We coordinate hosts and guests to share Thanksgiving meals together on November 26.

title: Fall Work Day & Decor Setup
description: Calling all volunteer elves to decorate our church with a festive touch and to start the holiday season off with a winter wonderland of goodness and kindness (Elf costumes optional). Join together with your brothers and sisters in Christ to care for our facilities and grounds. This year will also include bagels, coffee and OJ that will be provided in the morning and hot cocoa and christmas cookies to share afterward. Work activities will include raking leaves, light repairs, Christmas decorating, and more. All are welcome!

title: Christmas Service
description: Save the date! CPC Christmas Service, Saturday, December 12 at 5pm. More details to come!

title: Last Day Sunday School
description: Final Sunday School session of the fall semester before the Christmas and New Year break.

title: Last Day Weekly Lunches
description: Final weekly fellowship lunch of the fall semester following morning worship.

title: Decor Take-Down
description: Volunteer work morning to pack away the Christmas greenery and sanctuary decorations.

title: Sunday School Resumes
description: Children's Sunday School and Adult Sunday Studies resume for the spring semester at 9:30am.

title: Weekly Lunches Resume
description: Sunday fellowship lunches return in the Fellowship Hall following morning worship.

title: Women’s Service Project
description: Morning of fellowship and hands-on service for women of all ages, supporting local community and mercy ministries.

title: Spring Work Day
description: Spring church cleaning and property maintenance. All hands welcome to help care for our historic building and grounds.

title: Good Friday Service
description: A reflective evening service of prayer, scripture, and music meditating on the cross and suffering of Jesus Christ.

title: Easter Fellowship Meals
description: Rejoice in the resurrection together! Share Easter dinner with church family following our celebratory morning worship.

title: Women’s Overnight Retreat
description: Annual overnight weekend retreat for women to step away for worship, rest, prayer, teaching, and sisterhood.

title: College and Grad School Sunday
description: Celebrating and praying for our graduating seniors, college students, and graduate students as the academic term wraps up.

title: Last Day of Sunday School
description: Final Sunday School session of the 2026–2027 academic year.

title: Last Day of Weekly Lunches
description: End-of-year celebratory fellowship lunch before summer schedule begins.

title: Youth Sunday
description: Our youth group students help lead elements of morning worship, sharing testimonies and God's work in their lives.

title: Summer Picnic Series Begins
description: Kickoff to our beloved Thursday Summer Picnics! Casual dinner, lawn games, and summer fellowship together.

title: Mom’s Discipleship Group
description: Please join us! Children are welcome to play near us while we meet. Future dates: No Dec, 1/13/27. Please inquire with any young mom, or Meg Bogue or Kristin Jensen with questions.
